name: My Son food guide
summary: The valley is not a food street. The ticket rules forbid eating in the monument area. VOV2 named mì Quảng and bê thui Cầu Mống at the 24 Mar 2022 night program. The sanctuary essay names mắm cái, a herring salad, and veal. The Da Nang Fatherland Front names the district’s fish sauce and other foods. A price is Check on arrival.
body: Eat before the gate. The My Son management board’s ticket information page forbids eating in the monument area. A management essay of 25 Feb 2025 still lists restaurants and local food as infrastructure the management board wants to build. The services index lists crafts and shows, not a market.

VOV2, on 23 Mar 2022, named mì Quảng and bê thui Cầu Mống at a night program in Thôn Mỹ Sơn. The program it describes began at 16:00 on 24 Mar 2022. On 1 Dec 2025 Tuổi Trẻ quotes the deputy in charge saying that night calendar is not fixed. Do not stay for a night that has not been announced.

The 24 Feb 2025 sanctuary essay, by Phan Văn Khoa, names mắm cái, gỏi made from cá mòi at the Thu Bon festival in Duy Thu, and thịt nghé as a specialty of lễ Bà. The Da Nang Fatherland Front names fish sauce, shrimp paste, a soft cake, rice paper, black-sesame oil, purple rice, a cereal, silkie eggs, dried lotus, and chả ốc from a farm in Duy Phú. Where a price or an hour was not printed, it is Check on arrival.
specialtiesLead: The plates and products the publishers name. A price is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Plates named for the valley
paragraphs: These are dishes, not stalls. VOV2 names two of them at one night program. The sanctuary essay names three more, and the Fatherland Front names the snail cake from Duy Phú. The hour, where it was not printed, is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Mi Quang
spots.note: Wide turmeric noodles and a small ladle of broth. Vietnam Tourism says the bowl is eaten across Quảng Nam. VOV2 named it at the 24 Mar 2022 night program in Thôn Mỹ Sơn and did not name a stall. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Be thui Cau Mong
spots.note: VOV2 names the plate at the same 24 Mar 2022 program and does not describe the meat. It is not the sanctuary essay’s sentence about thịt nghé. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Thit nghe
spots.note: Veal. The 24 Feb 2025 sanctuary essay says it became a specialty that draws visitors to lễ Bà. The essay does not say how it is cooked. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Goi ca moi
spots.note: Herring salad at the Thu Bon festival in Duy Thu. The 24 Feb 2025 essay calls gỏi a dish Cham people liked and does not give a dressing. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Mam cai
spots.note: The dipping bowl. The sanctuary essay traces it to Cham seafarers who salted fish. On 7 Feb 2025 the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism says it is salty, like Huế mắm nêm, and the aroma is not the same. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Cha oc
spots.note: The finished dish of a black apple-snail farm in Duy Phú. The Da Nang Fatherland Front’s 2024 note names the farm and does not describe the cake. The price is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Foods the district has recognized
paragraphs: These are foods of the old Duy Xuyên district, which held the sanctuary. The Da Nang Fatherland Front prints them as OCOP products. A star count is here only where the Fatherland Front prints one. A shop, a price, and an hour are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Nuoc mam Duy Trinh
spots.note: A 4-star product on the Fatherland Front’s OCOP account. The same sentence ends with thị trấn Nam Phước. A 2021 line puts the Duy Trinh fish-sauce workshop at thôn An Lương, xã Duy Hải. Both stay. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Nuoc mam nhi Cua Dai
spots.note: The OCOP account spells it nhĩ and lists it as a 2022 target, not yet among the recognized products. The 22–24 Sep 2023 fair spells it nhỉ and includes it among recognized OCOP products. No star count is printed there. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Mam ruoc Duy Trinh
spots.address: Thôn An Lương, xã Duy Hải
spots.note: A 3-star product in the 2021 list, made at the Duy Trinh fish-sauce workshop. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Banh deo Loi Pho
spots.address: Thôn An Lạc, xã Duy Thành
spots.note: A 3-star product. The Fatherland Front does not describe the cake. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Banh trang Hai An
spots.note: A 3-star rice paper. No method and no price were printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Dau me den
spots.address: Thôn Lang Châu Nam, xã Duy Phước
spots.note: Black-sesame oil, a 3-star product. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Gao tim than
spots.address: Thôn Vĩnh Nam, xã Duy Vinh
spots.note: Purple rice from Lò gạch cũ Farmstay, a 3-star product in the 2021 list. The 2023 fair names gạo tím than lò gạch cũ. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ngu coc
spots.address: Thôn Kiệu Châu, xã Duy Sơn
spots.note: The 2021 list says ngũ cốc Duy Anh, a 3-star product of hộ Phạm Thị Duy Mỹ. The 2023 fair says Ngũ cốc Duy Oanh. The 2024 note says Ngũ cố Duy Oanh. All three names stay. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Trung ga ac
spots.note: Silkie eggs from hộ Phạm Ngọc Anh, a 3-star product in the 2021 list. The sentence does not name the commune. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Sen say
spots.note: Dried lotus, named at the 22–24 Sep 2023 fair among recognized OCOP products. The fair does not print a village or a price. Check on arrival.
